definitions.explanation: A piece of furniture with drawers for storing clothes and other items. Traditional Japanese tansu are often made of paulownia wood.

examples.japanese: ⟦{洋服|ようふく}→洋服：05014_youfuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{箪笥|たんす}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しまいました→仕舞う：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: I put the clothes away in the dresser.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{箪笥|たんす}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{受|う}け{継|つ}いだ→受け継ぐ：06700_uketsugu⟧⟦もの→物：02259_mono⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: This chest of drawers was passed down from my grandmother.

examples.japanese: ⟦{桐|きり}→桐：27876_kiri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{箪笥|たんす}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し→引っ越し：03704_hikkoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦とき→時：02918_toki⟧、⟦{重|おも}い→重い：00804_omoi⟧{箪笥|たんす}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{運|はこ}んだ→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧。
examples.english: When moving, we carried the heavy chest of drawers between two of us.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦ごとに→ごとに：noentry⟧{箪笥|たんす}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中身|なかみ}→中身：01483_nakami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れ{替|か}えて→入れ替える：08227_irekaeru⟧、⟦{夏物|なつもの}→夏物：30667_natsumono⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{冬物|ふゆもの}→冬物：27498_fuyumono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{分|わ}けている→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧。
examples.english: My mother swaps out the contents of the dresser each season, separating summer and winter clothes.

notes:
{箪笥|たんす} - the kanji is complex and often written in hiragana.

Traditional types:
- ⟦{桐|きり}→桐：27876_kiri⟧{箪笥|たんす} (paulownia wood chest) - for kimono storage
- ⟦{階段|かいだん}→階段：00782_kaidan⟧{箪笥|たんす} (staircase tansu) - doubles as stairs
- ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧{箪笥|たんす} (wheeled tansu)
- ⟦{船|ふな}→船：00775_fune⟧{箪笥|たんす} (ship tansu) - used on boats

⟦{桐|きり}→桐：27876_kiri⟧ (paulownia) properties:
- Moisture resistant
- Protects from insects
- Lightweight yet durable
- Ideal for storing silk kimono

Expression:
- {箪笥|たんす}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{肥|こ}やし→肥やし：30665_koyashi⟧ (lit. "fertilizer for the dresser") - clothes that are bought and then never worn

Modern equivalents: ⟦チェスト→チェスト：30666_chesuto⟧ (a storage chest) and ⟦ドレッサー→ドレッサー：23739_doressaa⟧ (a vanity table with a mirror, not a chest of drawers - the English and Japanese senses differ).
